code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    if h % 2 and len(set(grid[h // 2])) == 1:
        i = h // 2
        a, b = grid[:i], grid[i + 1:]
    elif w % 2 and len({grid[r][w // 2] for r in range(h)}) == 1:
        i = w // 2
        a = [row[:i] for row in grid]
        b = [row[i + 1:] for row in grid]
    else:
        raise ValueError("central separator not found")
    shared = set(x for row in a for x in row) & set(x for row in b for x in row)
    if len(shared) != 1:
        raise ValueError("expected one shared color")
    background = next(iter(shared))
    return [[3 if a[r][c] == background and b[r][c] == background else background
             for c in range(len(a[0]))] for r in range(len(a))]
'''
